ephemeris.processing: Hourly sub-observer coordinates and distances, longitude unwrapping and a lunar rotation correction during light travel time.

terrain.processing: Grid sampling, compressed elevation storage, fixed-light hillshade and sampled horizon profiles. The three rim points were selected computationally. The 480 m display grid averages 2 x 2 original 240 m cells and rounds to 0.5 m. The interactive 80 km terrain patch uses a local tangent frame and lunar curvature. Display height exaggeration, lighting and WebGL shadows are illustrative, independent of the original visibility calculation.

coordinates.status: Approximate reference coordinates; not certified mission planning coordinates.

tools: AI coding assistants used during earlier project preparation
generativeAIAssistance.distinction: The source ephemerides and terrain are scientific provider data, not language-model predictions or generated imagery. AI-assisted code deterministically processes them.
